artifacts.name: the introductory DocAble case: accessibility obligations and the user-facing result

prior_chapter_shape.note: The originating case establishes the accessibility obligation, the engineering experiment, and context-dependent semantic judgments before the agentic machinery. The requirements table and interface glimpse carry the introductory evidence. The earlier internal architecture and preservation-validator walkthrough are archived; Chapters 2–5 teach the representations, controls, engineering process, and case evidence.
prior_chapter_shape.opening_anchor: The engineering methodology described in this book emerged from six months of
prior_chapter_shape.closing_anchor: productive machinery used to build it and the properties engineering must accommodate.
